_readme: Input data for the live ConceptDigger tests. 'kind' is 'category' (dig a Wikipedia category) or 'article' (hydrate one article and check its label, alternate names, redirects and disambiguation text). To add a test: append an entry here AND create debug_data/expected_output/<id>.json. To remove one: delete both. 'id' must be unique and filename-safe. Keep category cases small (max_depth 0). Article cases cost 4 live SPARQL calls each.

cases.description: Categories and member articles, including label, alternate-name, redirect and disambiguation synonyms.
Same category with return_pages=false: only sub-categories may appear in the output.
Negative case: a category that does not exist must produce HTTP 404 'Category not found' (one live ASK query).
Article input. Checks the English label, redirect surface text (element 2, helium gas) and disambiguation text (he).
Article input. Checks redirects (argon gas, element 18) and disambiguation text, including the stripped '(disambiguation)' suffix (a, ar).
Article input with a parenthesised title. Checks the label, the alternate name 'mercury', and redirect surface text.
